persons.name: Dhanarājadeva
persons.evidence: dvija śrīdhanarāja devaṇa, likhitam saṃpūrṇṇaṃ ... idaṃ pustakaṃ svapāṭhārthaṃ likhitaṃ ... vipraśrīdhanarājena likhyate

date.as_written: samvat 750 kārttikaśukla paṃcamyāṃ tithau, muraṇakṣatra (!) śubhajoga, āditya vārasa ... nepālavatsare jāte vyomakhādahayāmite kārtikasya site pakṣe paṃcamyām ca tithau dine mūle vā śubhamyoje ca ravivāreṇa saṃyute

notes: The prose date gives samvat 750, while the chronogram 'vyomakhādahayāmite' was interpreted by the cataloguer possibly as 760 or another reading.
